title: eludite/nuget/installed
description: The packages of the open solution's projects (Visual Studio's Installed tab): from each project's project.assets.json (top-level and transitive packages, resolved versions, the requested ranges and target frameworks) and its PackageReference items, or Directory.Packages.props's PackageVersion items under Central Package Management; the source from the global packages folder's .nupkg.metadata. A project that is not restored lists its PackageReference items with `restored: false`; a packages.config project is listed read-only with a migration note. Reads files only, unless `metadata` asks the sources for vulnerability and deprecation data (registration resource, cached per source).

generation.description: The solution generation the call is issued under (host-rpc.md, "Solution generation"). A value that is not current is -32801; a generation change while the call runs cancels it with -32801.

operation.description: The shell's id for this call (from 1): eludite/nuget/update notifications and eludite/nuget/credentials requests caused by it carry it, so the shell can route the Package Manager output and know who asked.

projects.description: Absolute paths of projects of the open solution. Omitted: every project the solution lists.

includeTransitive.description: List transitive packages too (default false: top-level only).

metadata.description: Ask the sources' registration data for vulnerabilities and deprecation of each listed version (default false: only NuGet Audit's warnings recorded in the assets file). The answers also go out as an eludite/nuget/update `metadata` notification.

interactive.description: Whether the shell may be asked for credentials (eludite/nuget/credentials) during this call: true for the person's calls, false (the default) for agents', whose calls fail with `credentials_required` instead. Credential providers run either way.

format.description: packageReference: PackageReference items (SDK-style and migrated legacy projects). packagesConfig: the legacy packages.config, listed read-only (`note` says how to migrate). none: no packages.

restored.description: project.assets.json exists; without it versions are the requested ones and nothing is transitive.

centralPackageManagement.description: ManagePackageVersionsCentrally is true: versions live in `propsFile`.

propsFile.description: The Directory.Packages.props that holds the versions under Central Package Management.

lockFile.description: The project's packages.lock.json, when it has one.

requested.description: The requested version or range as the project file (or Directory.Packages.props under Central Package Management) writes it; omitted for a transitive package.

version.description: The version restore resolved (project.assets.json); omitted when the project is not restored.

targetFrameworks.description: The project's target frameworks that reference it.

source.description: The source it was restored from (the global packages folder's .nupkg.metadata), when known.

transitive.description: Brought in by another package, not referenced by the project.

autoReferenced.description: Added by the SDK (an implicit reference); it cannot be removed or updated here.

items.description: A known vulnerability of this version, from the source's registration data (or NuGet Audit's NU1901 to NU1904 warnings in the assets file).

severity.description: The advisory's severity (NuGet's 0 low, 1 moderate, 2 high, 3 critical).

advisoryUrl.description: The advisory's address (a GitHub advisory for nuget.org).

alternatePackage.description: The package the owner recommends instead.

error.description: Why the project's packages could not be read.

note.description: A remark for the window (the packages.config migration note).

cached.description: Answered from the session's cache for this source (no request was made).

error.description: Why this source failed (unreachable, 401 without credentials, an invalid feed). The other sources' results still count; the window shows an error row for this one.
